entries.zh: 下围棋，即对弈棋局之戏；西语 axedres（棋盘棋戏）相配，首字“围/图”字形存疑
entries.en: to play at chess (axedres); Chinese gloss weiqi (Go), first character uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏首字“围/图”存疑；M 栏四音节（oj quy hi gi）与二字汉栏不齐，R 栏 alaytabla 读音未能解，唯 L/H 棋戏义互证明确。

entries.zh: 着棋，即下棋、落子对弈
entries.en: to play chess; lit. to set down pieces (make a move)

entries.zh: 着来着去，谓来回摆弄、玩个不停；第二字“未/来”存疑，按 M 音 lay 当为“来”
entries.en: to play, to keep on playing (andar jugando); Chinese: doing back and forth
entries.notes: H 栏第二字“未/来”存疑。

entries.zh: 打双六，掷骰行棋之戏（双陆一类骰戏）
entries.en: to play at dice; lit. to play shuangliu, a dice-and-board game

entries.zh: 掷骰子，掷骰为戏
entries.en: to throw the dice; to play at dice

entries.zh: 打杆乐，即抽陀螺、打陀螺之戏
entries.en: to play at the spinning top (trompo)
entries.notes: “杆乐”即闽南“干乐（陀螺）”，与 trompo 相合。

entries.zh: 打毬，即玩球、打球之戏
entries.en: to play ball; to play at the ball game (pelota)

entries.zh: 打绵毬，掷拍绵球（棉团球）之戏；“绵/锦”字形存疑
entries.en: to play ball; lit. to hit a cotton ball (or brocade ball; character uncertain)

entries.zh: 抹水，玩水泼溅嬉戏
entries.en: to play splashing in the water (chapaleando); lit. to dabble with water
entries.notes: M 栏作 bag chuy / boa，斜杠旁音 boa 未明；“抹水”与西语泼水嬉戏义相合。

entries.zh: 打子仔，打弹子、玩小珠之戏
entries.en: to play at balls; lit. to hit little balls (marbles)

entries.zh: 跋棍（槌）相击，耍棍棒对打之戏；字形存疑
entries.en: to play fencing (esgrimir) with a couple of sticks; lit. to strike with clubs, characters uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏“跋棔/棍思”字形存疑，M 音 poa-tuy-cuy 或含“槌”义；四栏于“棍棒相击之戏”义互证。

entries.zh: 跋狮，扑翻狮形之戏（西语谓“翻倒狮子” boltear vn leon）
entries.en: to play at toppling a lion (boltear un león); lit. to knock down a lion figure

entries.zh: 跋葫芦问，掷骰走格的“葫芦问”图棋，对译西语“鹅棋”（juego de la oca）
entries.en: to play the huluwen (Gourd Inquiry) board game; matched to the Spanish game of the goose (juego de la oca)

entries.zh: 跋牌仔，打纸牌、玩牌之戏
entries.en: to play at cards (naipes); lit. to flip/slap cards

entries.zh: 铺牙牌，摆弄骨牌（牙牌）配骰之戏
entries.en: to play with small tiles (bone tablets) and dice, i.e. dominoes

entries.zh: 帮赌，替人合本下注、对半分彩之赌；“帮/幫”字形存疑
entries.en: to play for another on shares (a medias); lit. to back gambling
entries.notes: H 栏“帮/幫”存疑；M 栏 puy guiau / tou 含斜杠旁音 tou，与二字汉栏不齐。

entries.zh: 行令，行酒令以定谁饮
entries.en: to play at who drinks; lit. to give the drinking orders

entries.zh: 酒令，饮酒行令之戏，以令定罚饮
entries.en: drinking game; the wine command decides who drinks

entries.zh: 打陆（打六），一种行棋之戏，对译西洋跳棋（damas）
entries.en: to play at draughts (damas); lit. to hit six (da liu), a Chinese board game

entries.zh: 投壶，投矢入壶之古戏；西语谓掷小苇签（cañuelas）
entries.en: to play at throwing little reeds (cañuelas); the game of touhu, pitching arrows into a pot

entries.zh: 妖术，行妖法、施咒之术（“玩法术”）
entries.en: to play at magic and conjuring (magi corul, prob. magia conjuro); Chinese gloss: sorcery
entries.notes: 西语 magi corul 为残讹词形；M 栏另旁音 jia cau（疑“作咒/教咒”类）待考，义据 H 栏妖术。

entries.zh: 有法能变，身怀法术、能变化之术；“变/變”异体存疑
entries.en: to play at magic (magi coral); Chinese: to have an art able to transform
entries.notes: 西语词形与上条同属 magi 系残讹；H 栏“变/變”异体存疑。
